name: Red Stone Gems
source:
Here in Lymel Lye, there are monsters.
And on this night,  Anastasia is being stalked by the very worst one.

[From [url=https://oeharts.itch.io/redstonegems]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在莱梅尔莱这片土地上，潜伏着诸多怪物。
而在这个夜晚，阿娜斯塔西娅正被其中最穷凶极恶的那一头暗中尾随。

[摘自[url=https://oeharts.itch.io/redstonegems]itch.io[/url]]
